notes.title: Bloody Forest V2.0: New Map: Winter ; New object: the tracker
notes.content:
[h1]New Map: WINTER[/h1]

[h3]Here is an entire new map, Winter with new houses, camps and a miner's cave.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224344/8caa7ed49ba461ca4e6c0a0d02a5f83e4319b060.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224344/40808912cb37c0c3e637caabc285670812944af9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224344/5f9a42039fb605fc5351b21923af89ff7943b6d8.png[/img]

[h1]New Item: Tracker[/h1]

[h3]As you can imagine, this item gives you the ability to know the distance between you and the monster. Just be careful not to keep it on for too long.[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224344/df51807d34625859e96214d5b0d62e405c00b36c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224344/be6ae798d71ba6ba466ea78db9f777c0bcccef53.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Revamped inventory system and new drop system[/h2]

I changed the inventory system to a more powerful system where you can select one of your two items to use or drop.

[h2]Monster Updated[/h2]
[list]
[*]Customization of monsters: you can change the colors of the monster according to your level (new orange color added for Halloween)
[*]Monster's Ai updated (turning off the light is now useful)
[*]Improved gameplay of monsters played by players (fast hits, improved camera, and sound)
[/list]

[h2]Bug and changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Items were not spawning when dropped
[*]Monster attack sound while monster was a player
[*]Deformation of the landscape
[*]Die animations changed
[*]Movements glitch
[/list]


If you have any question or issue, please join the Bloody Forest Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/7ySRHSwzKB
